description: Paid endpoint ($0.002): one Hyperliquid perp's funding (hourly, 8h, annualized, next_funding_time ISO-8601 UTC + time_to_next_seconds), open interest in USD, 24h volume, mark/oracle price, premium and whether it is in the top-10 funding extremes. Any listed Hyperliquid perp, incl. HIP-3 builder dexes (xyz:TSLA; rank null); unknown symbols return an error and no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL. Free sample response: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/perps

symbol.description: Hyperliquid perp ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE; HIP-3 builder-dex perps as dex:TICKER, e.g. xyz:TSLA

name: get_perps
title: Perps radar (paid, x402) — $0.002

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
